title: The Hollow Moon
text: A moon hangs low over the dark, close enough to touch, pale and pocked and enormous. It is hollow. You can hear the wind moaning inside it. There is a door in it, small and wooden, with a brass knocker shaped like a hand.

options.label: Climb up and go into the moon, and see who lives there.

outcomes.text: A room of silver dust, and a gift laid out on a table, and the wind moaning your names.
A room of silver dust, and its keeper, who is very lonely and very hungry.

options.label: The wisest knocks first, as any guest should.

outcomes.text: Something knocks back, slowly, and the moon drifts higher, out of reach.

options.label: Walk away from it. No moon should hang so low.

outcomes.text: It follows for a while, low and close, moaning.
